name: Vanthorpe Voidskin Chrome Reveal Night Set
description: Vanthorpe's nightlife answer to their daywear chrome-reveal suits — this is Tier 4 club couture built around the philosophy that augmentation is the garment, and fabric is just context. The jacket is a collarless, single-button construction in deep void-black micro-weave fabric with a subtle structural sheen, cut long and slim to the knee at the back and cropped asymmetrically to hip-level at the front. The right sleeve terminates at the elbow with a precisely finished chrome-edged cuff — designed for wearers with full arm augmentation from the elbow down, so the chrome prosthetic becomes the sleeve's continuation. The left sleeve is full-length with a row of small chrome-plate accent panels running along the outer forearm. Beneath: a collarless inner garment of matte black reactive-mesh that clings to the torso and becomes slightly translucent when body temperature rises past a threshold — revealing the body's topology in heat-mapped amber tones. Trousers are slim and high-waisted in the same void-black micro-weave, with a chrome inseam stripe that runs from inner ankle to mid-thigh on both legs, and a discreet rear vent for tail-free geneware accommodation. Footwear is Vanthorpe's signature pointed-toe Chelsea boot in chrome-cap synth-leather, matte body with a mirrored toe box. The entire set reads as restrained until the chrome arm catches light — and then it's the only thing in the room.
functionality: Right sleeve terminates for elbow-down chrome arm prosthetic integration. Reactive-mesh inner layer becomes translucent above body-temperature threshold. Chrome inseam stripes are conductive and can interface with compatible leg augmentation displays. Pointed-toe boot cap is reinforced chrome-composite. BCI port accessible at nape via hidden panel.
what_it_says: Power worn quietly until the moment it isn't. This is someone who has spent money on their body — chrome that cost more than most people's annual salary — and has bought clothes that know how to get out of the way and let it show. Tier 4 confidence: not flashy, just certain.
worn_by: specialist professionals with high-grade limb augmentations
augmentation showcase enthusiasts in Tier 4 club circuits
chrome-arm wearers who want tailoring, not accommodation
story_hooks: The conductive chrome inseam stripes are compatible with a specific model of military-grade leg augmentation that's supposed to be off the civilian market — a security sweep at the club entrance flags the outfit as carrying restricted hardware signals.

A Vanthorpe rep corners the wearer in the VIP section, offering a modeling contract for the new chrome-reveal campaign — but the contract's fine print requires full biometric licensing of the wearer's augmentation data.
Someone at the bar is wearing an identical right-sleeve termination cut — but their chrome arm beneath it is a match for hardware that went missing from a corporate vault six weeks ago.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, monochromatic silhouette that whispers luxury until caught by light. The asymmetrical jacket creates a sharp geometric statement—cropped in front, elongated at the back—while the exposed chrome arm extension transforms augmentation into haute couture. The outfit reads as controlled restraint with surgical precision.
physical_description.fit: Slim and tailored throughout. High-waisted trousers with a lifted silhouette. Jacket is body-conscious at the torso, elongating the frame with its asymmetric hemline. The chrome-edged right sleeve sits perfectly at the elbow, designed for prosthetic continuation.
physical_description.primary_material: Void-black micro-weave synthetic fabric with subtle structural sheen (jacket and trousers). Matte black reactive-mesh inner garment that responds to body temperature. Chrome-cap synth-leather boots with mirrored toe box.
physical_description.texture: Jacket and trouser fabric has a fine, almost liquid-like sheen—smooth to the eye but with dimensional micro-structure. Reactive-mesh inner has a tactile, clinging quality. Chrome accents are polished mirror-finish, creating stark contrast against matte surfaces.
physical_description.color_scheme: Monochromatic void-black as primary, with high-contrast polished chrome in silver-white. Heat-mapped amber tones emerge on the reactive-mesh layer when body temperature rises. Mirrored chrome toe caps on boots catch and reflect ambient light.
physical_description.closures: Single chrome-plate button at jacket center (functional and decorative). Magnetic closure implied at cuff edges. Reactive-mesh inner adheres via friction-fit to skin. Trousers likely feature discrete magnetic or friction closure at waistband.
distinctive_features: Asymmetrical jacket hemline—hip-length front, knee-length back
Elbow-terminating right sleeve with chrome-finished cuff designed for prosthetic arm continuation
Left forearm chrome-plate accent panel row
Reactive-mesh inner layer that becomes translucent and heat-mapped amber at body temperature threshold
Chrome inseam stripe running inner ankle to mid-thigh on both trouser legs
Discreet rear trouser vent for geneware/tail accommodation
Mirrored chrome toe-cap Chelsea boots with pointed toe
Void-black micro-weave with structural sheen throughout
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4 working-class luxury. Premium club couture—expensive enough to signal status, but designed for active nightlife rather than corpo boardrooms.
physical_description.cultural_context: Nightlife circuit, augmentation-positive culture. Wearer is likely active in GLMZ club scenes, proud of prosthetic augmentation, and financially stable within working-class parameters. Communicates: 'My augmentation is beautiful, and I designed the garment around it.'
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine and maintained. Chrome accents regularly polished. Reactive-mesh layer shows faint heat-marks after wear but returns to matte state. Void-black micro-weave resists visible wear; scratches are minimal on first-generation pieces. Worn with intention, never casually.
